title: Well-posedness of stochastic reacting particle systems with non-local and Lennard-Jones interactions
summary: We establish well-posedness results for systems of a finite number of stochastic particles driven by independent Brownian motions and subject to a strongly singular drift induced by a Lennard-Jones interaction. In addition to the pairwise force, the dynamics includes a nonlocal drift mediated by an environmental field, whose evolution is coupled to the particle configuration through a regularized empirical density.
